scope: Private isolated test operator helpers; no helper/runtime files are committed.
reviewedSafetyProperties: Exact loopback database name and port guard plus exactly two reviewed DEMO_SYNTHETIC organizations.
Mutations limited to allowlisted tables and explicit Horizon rows; affected row counts checked.
One active mutation/fault/delay case at a time; compound no-assign cases explicitly tracked.
Restoration compares targeted changed fields or deleted rows with private pre-mutation snapshots; inserted temporary rows must be absent.
Fault triggers use an owned name and are removed without disabling the four product immutable-history guards.

Pending layout lock uses a nominal 20-second hold followed by transaction ROLLBACK, with 25-second statement and idle timeouts; measured setup/release duration is retained and excluded from performance.
limits: Execution/restoration proof must come from each case and final integrity artifacts, not this code review.
